topic: Giacomo Rizzolatti (1992, 1996) Discovery of Mirror Neurons in Premotor Area F5, Goal-Coding Mechanisms, Hickok (2014) Critique, and Human Single-Unit Empathy Resonance (Low-Poly Pastel v7)
act5_climax_episode: Direct human single-neuron recordings in 21 neurosurgical patients confirming mirror neurons in human motor and anterior cingulate/insular circuits, grounding action simulation within a broader semantic network.
